name: Fox Mask
source:
You have a pretty normal life, working in a flower shop on the high street and living in a small and comfortable apartment.

But it all starts to go wrong when you realise that events that haunted you in the past have come back. Maybe you can run away, but are you ready to see how your friends die without being able to do ANYTHING for them?

[From [url=https://themonsterlive-36.itch.io/fox-mask]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你过着很正常的生活，在大街上的一家花店工作，住在一套小而舒适的公寓里。

但当你意识到过去困扰你的事情又回来了时，一切都开始出错了。也许你可以逃跑，但你准备好看到你的朋友如何死去却无法为他们做任何事吗？

[来自[url=https://themonsterlive-36.itch.io/fox-mask]Itch.io[/url]]
